attempt1Failure.classification: a timing-sensitive test, not infrastructure: the probe's own threshold for the native decay (the Control must show at least 5 distinct values) failed because Godot's uncapped headless loop delivered frames in pairs, 57 ms apart and then 0.4 ms apart, and RN's decay driver ended at the near-duplicate frame by its own rule, leaving 4 distinct values. The values were right for the delivered timestamps; the project later replaced the fixed threshold with pacing-independent rules (commits 381a8b4 and 634285f, merged with #42) and made the frame cadence display-paced (the frame clock, #43)

limits: All five jobs completed successfully in the final attempt; this artifact audit certifies only the headless current Animated lane (75 checks).

The preceding-host control (59) and the two retained sabotages (32 and 2) remain local evidence; this audit only shows that every check they fail passes in the hosted run. The first attempt failed on a timing-sensitive check of the native decay and attempt 2 passed it on the same commit: both are recorded, and a pass on rerun does not make the check pacing-independent (the project replaced it later).
Bundle hashes and the native host hash are declared by the runner; no bundle or native binary is included in the artifact.
CI host hash is not required to equal the local built host.
Mobile and parity jobs are separate: only their PASSED markers are recorded, their outputs are not audited here.
Git-tree verification establishes tracked content at the pushed main checkout; it does not independently inspect a compiled native binary.
The slice's own committed limits are unchanged and still apply:

The suite asserts only props without layout effects (opacity, translation, rotation); exploratory runs of width and marginLeft with the native driver followed frame by frame (RN's backend commits layout updates), but they are not part of the receipt.

LayoutAnimation, layout transitions, native Animated.event on the SDK ScrollView, Animated.Text/Image/ScrollView/FlatList/SectionList, PlatformColor interpolation, unstable_disableBatchingForNativeCreate and reduced motion are not covered.
A uniform transform [{scale}] fails with E_TRANSFORM_3D (pre-existing transforms guard); animate scaleX and scaleY.
Behavior under JS load, across background and resume, frame and heap budgets (GF-30), hardware and Godot Android and iOS exports are not executed.
No whole GF, other checkpoint, dependency, weight or denominator closed; only GF-19's first-slice checkpoint.
